title: Land EPI sub-indicator grain in fact_epi_score — unpivot the 30+ indicators wide→long
description: FB-001 (resolved 2026-08-04 → full sub-indicator grain) found that fact_epi_score holds 180 rows (one per country, overall EPI score only) while the spec, gold_tables.md, the DAX library, and the live TMDL all specify grain = country × indicator × year with the 30+ EPI sub-indicators pivoted to long. The spec is correct; the implementation is the outlier. Root cause is one layer upstream of where FB-001 placed it: bronze-to-silver.Notebook:227 drops the 30+ indicator columns (df_selected = df_multi_casted.select("code", "iso", "country", "EPI")) right after clean_and_rename (L211-222) had carefully preserved them (drops .old, strips .new). By the time silver-to-gold2 reads silver_epi{year}results only the overall EPI survives, so the gold unpivot has nothing to unpivot. Fix = (1) bronze-to-silver selects all 30+ indicator columns into silver, (2) silver-to-gold2 unpivots wide→long into fact_epi_score (country_key, indicator_key, year, score) joining to gold_dim_indicator on abbreviation, (3) deploy the Weighted EPI Score measure to the TMDL. No src/ mirror exists for the EPI transform (src/transformations covers data_quality/key_gen/procurement_dates/supply_risk/watermark only; grep for 'epi' in src/ is empty), so the CLAUDE.md tested-mirror contract does not bind this task. The wide→long unpivot + dim_indicator join is pure DataFrame logic and is locally testable per the CLAUDE.md gotcha (build the SparkSession with spark.sql.ansi.enabled=false); only saveAsTable/lakehouse I/O is Fabric-only.
acceptanceCriteria: bronze-to-silver.Notebook preserves the 30+ EPI sub-indicator columns into silver_epi{year}results (typed DOUBLE) in addition to code, iso, country — not only the overall EPI column. The .old/.new vintage-suffix handling in clean_and_rename (L211-222) is preserved unchanged.

silver-to-gold2.Notebook unpivots the 30+ wide indicator columns → long format into fact_epi_score with grain country × indicator × year and columns country_key, indicator_key, year, score. indicator_key joins to gold_dim_indicator on abbreviation. The overall EPI composite is handled explicitly (included as one indicator row OR excluded from the sub-indicator set) and the choice is documented in the completion notes.

The Weighted EPI Score measure is deployed to fact_epi_score.tmdl matching the DAX library definition (score × RELATED(gold_dim_indicator[weight])). Avg EPI Score and Countries with EPI Data remain correct — filtered to the overall EPI where needed so sub-indicator rows do not pollute the per-country average.

Local Spark verification per the CLAUDE.md gotcha: the wide→long unpivot + dim_indicator join is exercised against an in-memory EPI fixture with spark.sql.ansi.enabled=false, asserting the expected country × indicator row shape and that an overall EPI value is preserved through the transform. Delta saveAsTable / lakehouse I/O remains the Fabric-only ceiling and is not claimed locally.

Erik-gated Fabric run + report non-regression: bronze→silver→gold runs clean in Fabric; fact_epi_score row count reflects the sub-indicator grain (~180 countries × ~30+ indicators, exact count documented post-run); the report visuals on page 4d6bd5ea… render correct Avg EPI Score / Countries with EPI Data values; task-036's EPI e2e baseline overall-EPI figures are not regressed.
notes: CREATED 2026-08-04 (/work, Erik-approved) from FB-001 after /grill resolved the doc-fix-vs-implementation-gap fork by reading. Origin: task-036 close-out (EPI/WGI e2e baseline) surfaced that fact_epi_score held 180 rows of overall-EPI-only against a spec/dim/DAX/TMDL that all specify country × indicator × year. Both notebooks must change.

WHY owner=both AND why Claude can act first (so this is In Progress, not Blocked): ACs 1-4 are local code edits + a local Spark logic test — no Fabric access needed. Only AC5 requires Erik to run the pipeline in Fabric. Same shape as task-053's Phase A.

NO src/ MIRROR: src/transformations covers data_quality, key_generation, procurement_dates, supply_risk, watermark — there is no EPI transform module and grep for 'epi' in src/ is empty. The CLAUDE.md tested-mirror contract does not bind this task. (If a later check finds an EPI reference in src/ it must be updated for parity, but none was found at creation.)

LOCAL SPARK CEILING: the wide→long unpivot + dim_indicator join is pure DataFrame logic — locally testable per the CLAUDE.md gotcha. Build the verification SparkSession with spark.sql.ansi.enabled=false (local defaults ANSI on, Fabric off, cast semantics diverge). The saveAsTable/lakehouse write is the genuine Fabric-only ceiling — do not claim it locally.

LATENT, NOT LIVE BREAKAGE: no report visual currently slices by gold_dim_indicator; the three live visuals on page 4d6bd5ea… consume Avg EPI Score / Countries with EPI Data (both aggregate score over countries and work on overall-EPI-only). Weighted EPI Score lives only in the DAX library doc today, not deployed in the TMDL. So this is correct-by-spec, dormant-by-implementation — AC3 + AC5 close the dormancy.

TASK-042 COORDINATION: task-042 (EPI vintage parameterization) is Finished — bronze-to-silver already uses p_epi_year (L46) and EPI_YEAR for the table names. The new select widening must keep the parameterized table names and not re-hardcode 2024.

[IMPLEMENTED 2026-08-04 via implement-agent] 3 files modified. (1) bronze-to-silver.Notebook L227: widened the select from (code,iso,country,EPI) to keep ALL 30+ indicator columns, each cast DOUBLE; clean_and_rename vintage handling (.old drop / .new strip) unchanged, p_epi_year parameterization preserved. (2) silver-to-gold2.Notebook: the wide→long unpivot + dim_indicator join already existed and is correct once silver carries the 30+ columns — added an explicit comment block documenting the overall EPI composite handling choice (INCLUDED as one indicator row, abbrev='EPI'). (3) fact_epi_score.tmdl: deployed Weighted EPI Score per DAX library using source_system (the actual TMDL column, not the DAX library doc's stale indicator_source); fixed Avg EPI Score + Countries with EPI Data to filter on gold_dim_indicator[abbrev]='EPI' so sub-indicator rows do not pollute the per-country average — preserves task-036's overall-EPI baseline. Local Spark verification (AC4) PASSED 9/9: clean_and_rename vintage handling, widened select preserving 4 indicator cols, unpivot 3×4=12 rows at country×indicator×year, overall EPI preserved (USA=52.6/CHN=40.1/SWE=73.2), sub-indicator AIR preserved (USA=95.1), STRING-sourced CLT cast to DOUBLE, 0 NULL keys, ANSI=false confirmed (cast('XYZ' as double)->NULL). saveAsTable/lakehouse I/O NOT claimed locally (Fabric-only ceiling). Verify script at .claude/support/workspace/task-054-verify.py.

[DECISIONS — surfaced, both within AC-delegated scope] (1) Overall EPI composite INCLUDED as one indicator row (abbrev='EPI') alongside the 30+ sub-indicators, NOT excluded — matches EPI source shape + gold_dim_indicator (EPI composite has its own weight), preserves the pre-task-054 per-country overall row the live report visuals consume, keeps a single uniform grain. (2) Avg EPI Score + Countries with EPI Data filtered to gold_dim_indicator[abbrev]='EPI' (overall composite only) so sub-indicator rows don't pollute the per-country average — preserves task-036 baseline. Both were pre-authorized by AC2/AC3; recorded here for audit trail, not promoted to formal DEC records (not blocking, reversible).

[FRICTION LOGGED] FR-049 (design_contradiction, open): spec_v1 § Data Transformations L348-358 says 'Select only: code, iso, country, EPI columns' — stale, contradicts the grain spec at L507-518 + L234. Resolved in favor of widening per the authoritative grain; L348-358 needs /iterate. FR-050 (vocab_drift, open): DAX library (dax_measure_library.md § 5.1) uses gold_dim_indicator[indicator_source] but the actual TMDL column is source_system — deployed measures use source_system; DAX library doc needs updating (other measures referencing indicator_source would break if deployed verbatim).

[ISSUES DISCOVERED — non-blocking, candidate follow-up tasks] (a) Weighted EPI Score SUMX iterates over ALL fact rows including the overall EPI composite row (abbrev='EPI'), which is itself a weighted composite of the sub-indicators — may double-count in numerator and denominator; deployed as-written per AC3's 'matching the DAX library definition'; flag for a future DAX-review task. (b) DAX library indicator_source vs source_system drift — other library measures (Avg WGI Score, % Spend - High EPI Countries) break if deployed verbatim. Spec L348-358 staleness routed via FR-049.

[AC5 ERIK-GATED] Fabric pipeline run + report non-regression is Erik's half — not in this verification round. verify-agent scopes to ACs 1-4 (code + local Spark); AC5 stays open like task-053's Phase A increment.
